  "pros": [

    "Robust automation capabilities for email campaigns",
    "Good value for money, especially for essential features",

  ],
  "cons": [
    "Pricing can become expensive as subscriber lists grow or advanced features are needed",
    "Steep learning curve for advanced features and complex automations",
    "Limited customization options for templates and advanced reporting",
    "Reporting and analytics may lack depth for granular insights",
    "Performance issues can hinder user experience, especially on key pages",
    "Integrations with other tools can sometimes be limited or difficult to set up"
  ],
  "changed": [
    "Pro 1: The 'User-friendly interface' was refined to 'User-friendly navigation and clear organization of features' because the new user noted 'The sidebar clearly groups CRM... and Marketing... so the areas the task needs were easy to locate.', providing a more specific benefit regarding UI/UX.",
    "Con 5: 'Some users find the UI/UX clunky or less intuitive than competitors' was replaced with 'Performance issues can hinder user experience, especially on key pages' because the new user specifically encountered a critical performance issue: 'The Campaigns listing page showed only a spinner for 15+ seconds across three observations and never rendered, so I could not start the welcome, feature-update or promo drafts.', which is a more direct and impactful problem than general clunkiness."
  ]
}

cons: Pricing can become expensive as subscriber lists grow or advanced features are needed

changed: Pro 1: The 'User-friendly interface' was refined to 'User-friendly navigation and clear organization of features' because the new user noted 'The sidebar clearly groups CRM... and Marketing... so the areas the task needs were easy to locate.', providing a more specific benefit regarding UI/UX.

Con 5: 'Some users find the UI/UX clunky or less intuitive than competitors' was replaced with 'Performance issues can hinder user experience, especially on key pages' because the new user specifically encountered a critical performance issue: 'The Campaigns listing page showed only a spinner for 15+ seconds across three observations and never rendered, so I could not start the welcome, feature-update or promo drafts.', which is a more direct and impactful problem than general clunkiness.
